=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The #6668 change is only in the template. The live hook, which tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py loads through GUARD_PATH (line 27), still sends `gh api --help` to parse_gh_api_args. That raises Unreadable, so the call is still classed as a write and prompts.
  WHY: CI already shows the failure. tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates with drift on hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py, and the aggregate lint check fails with it. The same drift will fail test_template_parity in tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, and the new cases there run against the live copy. test_bare_help_is_a_read will get "ask" instead of "allow", and test_bare_help_piped_to_grep_gets_no_decision will get "ask" instead of None. Sessions in this repo also keep prompting on `gh api --help`. The issue's delivery constraint (Q40 / CLAUDE.md §28.C) gives this sync to the master session's `[claude-twin-sync]` commit. That commit is a byte-for-byte copy of the template over the live file. The PR cannot go green or merge until it lands. The editor cannot write this path, so this is a merge prerequisite and not an edit for this pass.
- Requirement: "The master session copies the file into `.claude/` in a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit." The tests the issue lists must also pass.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py, synced byte-for-byte from workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: The live copy has no `_BARE_HELP_ARGS`, `_is_bare_gh_api_help` or bare-help shortcut, and the CI parity check reports the drift. The issue gives this step to the master session, so it is outside the editor's scope but blocks merge.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
